title: 第1929章 犬皇痛骂叛友小人方圆背身大笑割袍第1928章 寒清漪闻旧名却步塔娜罗横身阻痴心
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
方圆沉默了。
他站在原地，目光死死盯着白发顾长歌那张面孔。
脑海中正在飞速翻涌着从第三层空门之后开始的每一个细节。
白发黑眸的出现、实力的暴涨、性格的骤变。
对那些原本亲近的人若即若离的态度。
他忽然想起了一件事。
在第三层空门开启之前，顾长歌虽然也沉默寡言、喜怒不形于色。
但他对待其他人的态度从来都是温和而可靠的。
而从空门中走出来的这个白发男人。
他连看寒清漪的眼神都是陌生的、冷漠的。
甚至带着一丝不耐烦的轻蔑。
那确实不像顾长歌。
或许，此刻的顾兄，有他的计划？或者，已经被空门内的存在给夺舍了？
方圆的喉结上下滚动了一下。
他深吸了一口气，然后将那口气缓缓吐出来。
“……是我认错了。”
这几个字从他嘴里说出来的瞬间。
犬皇的狗耳朵猛地竖了起来：
“汪汪！本皇就说吧！你他娘的果然认错了！”
韩力却显得有些失望的叹了口气。

“方圆道友，认错人也是常有的事，毕竟修仙界中易容换貌的手段太多了，不必太过自责。”
李长命站在队伍后方。
脸上带着一丝失望。
低声嘟囔道：
“诶，怎么就不是顾兄呢？”
“也不知道无尽火域一别，顾兄到底去了哪里？”
然而方圆没有理会众人的反应。
他的目光依旧落在白发顾长歌的身上。
那双眼眸深处翻涌着一丝只有他自己能懂的隐晦光芒。
‘我确实可能认错了人。但我也可能没有认错。’
‘如果他真的是顾兄，这其中必定有极其重大的隐情。如果我强行在此刻拆穿他的身份，只会害了他。’
‘无论他是与不是，最好的选择，都是先退一步。’
他收回了目光，转向犬皇和韩力的方向。
嘴角扯出一个略显勉强的笑容：
“抱歉啊诸位，是我唐突了。方才大战一场，气血上涌，脑子有些不清醒。大家别放在心上。”
犬皇的狗头猛点，狗尾巴翘得老高：
“没事没事！认错人算什么大事！本皇当年还把一个长着狗头的妖族当成同族了呢！结果那家伙是个化形失败的狼妖！差点把本皇给吃了！”
他一边说着一边迈着小碎步朝方圆和白宁冰的方向凑了过去。
content_en:
Fangyuan was silent.
He stood there, staring at the face of white-haired Gu Changge.
Every detail from after the empty door on the third floor was racing through my mind.
The appearance of white hair and black eyes, the sudden increase in strength, and the sudden change in personality.
A detached attitude towards those who are close to you.
He suddenly remembered something.
Before the empty door on the third floor opened, Gu Changge was taciturn and indifferent to emotions and anger.
But his attitude towards others was always gentle and reliable.
And the white-haired man walked out of the empty door.
Even the way he looked at Han Qingyi was unfamiliar and cold.
Even with a hint of impatient contempt.
That really doesn't look like Gu Changge.
Maybe Brother Gu has his own plan at this moment? Or, has it been taken away by the existence within the empty gate?
Fangyuan's Adam's apple rolled up and down.
He took a deep breath and let it out slowly.
"...I admitted my mistake."
The moment these words came out of his mouth.
The Dog King's dog ears suddenly stood up:
"Woof woof! Just say it, my emperor! You damn sure admitted your mistake!"
Han Li sighed a little disappointedly.
"Fellow Taoist Fangyuan, it is common to admit the wrong person. After all, there are many ways to change one's appearance in the world of immortality, so there is no need to blame yourself too much."
Li Changming stood at the back of the team.
There was a hint of disappointment on his face.
He muttered in a low voice:
"Hey, why isn't it Brother Gu?"
"I don't know where Brother Gu went after leaving the Endless Fire Realm?"
However, Fangyuan ignored everyone's reaction.
His eyes were still on the white-haired Gu Changge.
There was a faint light in the depths of those eyes that only he could understand.
'It's true that I may have mistaken the person. But I might not admit my mistake. ’
‘If he is really Brother Gu, there must be an extremely important hidden secret. If I forcefully expose his identity at this moment, it will only harm him. ’
'Whether he is or not, the best option is to take a step back. ’
He withdrew his gaze and turned in the direction of Dog King and Han Li.
A slightly forced smile appeared at the corner of his mouth:
"I'm sorry, everyone, I was rude. We just had a big battle, my blood is rising, and my brain is a little unclear. Don't take it to heart."
The dog king's head nodded fiercely, and his tail was raised high:
"It's okay! It's no big deal if you admit someone wrong! Back then, I thought a demon with a dog's head was a kin! It turned out that guy was a wolf demon who failed to transform! He almost ate me!"
As he spoke, he took small steps towards Fangyuan and Bai Ningbing.
